Started in one dairy, not a lab.

Milkline began as a single route: one farm outside town, one refrigerated van, six flavors mixed by hand in steel tanks. We still cap batches at 400 gallons so nothing sits long enough to need a stabilizer. The milk is pasteurized, never ultra-heated, which is why it tastes like the farm and not the carton.

No gimmicks.
Just milk that tastes like it should.

Delivered cold, poured fresh, gone by the weekend — the way milk was always meant to work.
